SavedDraft.title: SavedDraft
SavedDraft.description: User saved draft session with picks, bans, scores, and metadata

userId.description: User identifier who created or owns the draft

title.description: User provided title or match label for the draft

gameMode.description: Tournament, Ranked, or Global Ban Pick mode

bluePicks.description: List of blue team hero names picked

redPicks.description: List of red team hero names picked

blueBans.description: List of blue team hero bans

redBans.description: List of red team hero bans

blueScore.description: Calculated score or win advantage for blue team

redScore.description: Calculated score or win advantage for red team

gameNumber.description: Game index in a Best-of series

boSeries.description: Total games in series, e.g. 5 for Bo5

createdAt.description: ISO timestamp when draft was saved

updatedAt.description: ISO timestamp when draft was last updated

UserSettings.title: UserSettings
UserSettings.description: User custom settings, favorite heroes, and stats preferences

favoriteHeroes.description: List of user favorite hero names

autoSaveDrafts.description: Flag to automatically save draft changes

/users/{userId}/drafts/{draftId}.description: Individual draft session created and owned by a user

/shared_drafts/{draftId}.description: Publicly shared drafts accessible across devices via share link or ID
